svg.title: U1 Breath wiring schematic
svg.desc: Schematic of the U1 Breath chamber heater: 120 V mains path through fuse, SSR, thermal fuse, thermal protector and PTC element; HLK-10M24 AC-DC module; MP1584 buck; XIAO ESP32-C3; MOSFET-driven 24 V blower; WS2812B status LED; three 100K NTC dividers.
svg.text: 120 V, 300 W PTC chamber heater + 24 V blower, Seeed XIAO ESP32-C3 (DragonBreath fork). Schematic only: pins grouped by function, not board order. See wiring.md for the pin table.
MAINS 120 V - every box and wire in this band lives inside the electronics compartment, under the cover. Crimped terminals only.
its own M3 screw + star washer
only if the back plate carries
D3, D8 n.c. u.FL antenna on shell
Duct / PTC NTC: M3 ring lug on
the liner outer side face. B3950, 1%.
Bed probe NTC: M3 ring lug under the bed,
600 mm silicone lead, JST-XH 2-pin on unit.
common GND (all tie to HLK GND)
+5 V flag = same net as the buck output
Red-tinted boxes carry 120 V. Unplug before opening.
Mains: 18 AWG silicone, crimped spade/ring or ferrules. Low voltage: 22 AWG power, 24 AWG signals and NTC leads. Never run the heater with the blower unplugged. First power-up on a GFCI outlet.
